verdicts.reason: A: the CTA is a tiny pill at the far left, sitting on the decorative circle and barely legible. That makes the call to action the first thing read and cuts it off from the headline. The 'NEW FLAVOR' badge sits under the headline as if it were the button, the body copy is a 4-line block jammed at the right edge, and the SOLSTICE wordmark is missing. B: the body copy leads at the left as a cramped 3-line block, the CTA text is tiny and the can is shrunk to a speck at the right, and the logo is also missing. Still, B keeps the headline as the focal point with the badge and CTA grouped beneath it, so its reading order is less broken than A's.
